main_text.l: Sed nec doctrinis Papalibus, ut sunt Tran-
substantiatio, purgatorium, cultus imagi-
num, accrescit authoritas ab earum veritate,
bonitate, sanctitate, sed perinde ac ipsi Papæ
ab ejus imperio terreno divitiis, & pompâ
coruscante: id inde liquet, quod tam sint
futiles, & vacui capitis deliramenta quam
Alcorani dogmata, nec abfimilia imaginibus,
aut Ecclesiæ Romanæ aut Ethnicorum,
quæ ex forulis suis & præcelso loco extractæ, tum
humi projectæ, nullo loco aut numero habentur.
Incipiam à Transubstantiatione, cujus al-
ternis judiciis ambigo, an major sit aut fu-
tilitas aut impietas. Certè Costerus Jesuita,
& nuper Arnaldus Sorbonista affirmant, si
Christus non est realiter præsens per Transub-
stantiationem in Eucharistia, impietatem esse
superantem longé omnem idololatriam
Ethnicorum panem adorare. Id innuit Theo-
doretus

marginalia.note: Lib. I. art. 2. fol. 104 de Planctu Ecclesiæ.

page.notes: The marginal note at left is printed in small type beside the first paragraph; the mark "de" and "Planctu" are its only readable words. Several words in the scan are blurred (e.g. "fubstantiatio", "Papalibus" spelling as printed). The final word "doretus" at the foot is printed right-aligned and is probably the catchword-like continuation "Theodoretus"; it has been left as the last line of text.
